info.description: Case studies section: featured, latest, next or manual

anchor.description: DOM id / URL hash for this section (e.g. "industries" → #industries). Lets nav links target this section on the page.

pick.description: `manual` = show exactly the case studies you pick below. `latest` = the newest case studies in the whole Case Studies collection. `featured` = the ones marked as featured. `next` = the newest, excluding the current page. Only `manual` uses your own picks.

limit.description: How many case studies to show. Ignored when Selection is `manual`, which shows every pick.

caseStudies.description: Only used when Selection is `manual`. On a Service or Case Study page, leave it empty to show that page's own related case studies instead — so the page always has cases even before you curate them here. Picking even one case switches that automatic set off.
